product_from_film: Lightreel presents natural-language search and analysis of advertising examples and creators.
explains_well: Each query is paired with a visible set of matching-looking ad or creator cards.
unclear: The film does not show an analysis answer or evidence that a suggested change improves results.
scenario: Find creators, formats and ad examples with a typed question, then ask how to improve ad return.
product_clear_basis: A creator-search query at 7s is followed by creator video cards at 8s.

scenes.action: A collage of advertisements shrinks into a much denser field under largest labelled ads collection text. A textured blue-and-yellow crescent scene replaces it.
scenes.design: Tall serif white lettering; ad collage and painterly blue material.
scenes.purpose: Announce collection scale and visual identity.
scenes.evidence: 1 fps source samples in 0–6s; state changes visible, exact transition timing/easing unverified.

scenes.action: A query asks for creators partnered with Granola; five portrait cards appear. A cream flower field replaces the blue scene, with a format-search query and result cards.
scenes.design: Prompt box retains its shape while colors and background change.
scenes.purpose: Show two research tasks using the same input/result pattern.
scenes.evidence: 1 fps source samples in 6–13s; state changes visible, exact transition timing/easing unverified.

scenes.action: Find any ad, format, creator and analyze any ad headings accompany changing prompts and surrounding ad cards. A software before-and-after search appears last.
scenes.design: Flower and foliage textures in dark blue, orange, cream and green; large serif headings.
scenes.purpose: Expand the range of searchable categories.
scenes.evidence: 1 fps source samples in 13–20s; state changes visible, exact transition timing/easing unverified.

scenes.action: A plain white prompt types How can I increase my ROAS? A black free-trial URL card follows without an answer.
scenes.design: Minimal white input, then centered white serif URL on black.
scenes.purpose: Move from retrieval toward improvement and invite a trial.
scenes.evidence: 1 fps source samples in 20–24.613s; state changes visible, exact transition timing/easing unverified.

categories.finding: Collection announcement leads to repeated query/result examples, then an unanswered improvement question and trial link.
Dense ad cards and introducing the largest text appear immediately; by 2s the collection label is visible. Product scale is asserted before use.
Advertisers looking for references are implied by creator, format and ad prompts. Retrieval is clear at 8s.
The opening collage changes scale; prompt text fills and result cards appear around it. Continuous paths and easing are unresolved.
The query box stays recognizable across major color/background changes, providing continuity. Exact transitions are unverified.
Painterly moon, flowers and foliage contrast with clean prompt cards; decorative texture can compete with small results.
Large find/analyze headings summarize each state. Detailed queries and result labels need more space than the rapid sequence provides.
Voice delivery is unverified.
Music character and structure are unverified.
Effects and their sources are unverified.
categories.reason: No validated listening; waveform peaks do not identify effects.

categories.finding: Sound sync is unverified.
categories.reason: No validated listening or paired audiovisual timing.

categories.finding: Ad images and creator cards are placed over painterly scenes. Their original sources and the background production method are unknown.
Source duration 24.613 s; Watch metadata 3840 × 2160. Frame rate, audio clipping and export quality not checked here.
categories.reason: Parent source metadata supports duration and dimensions; visual review is sampled.

categories.finding: Queries plus results communicate research without sound. The final performance-improvement claim has no visible answer.
The large heading and central prompt guide the eye, while surrounding cards demonstrate variety at the cost of reading time.
Four capabilities arrive within about seven seconds at 13–20s. Each is an example category rather than a complete readable demonstration.
categories.experiment: Keep one prompt and three result cards on screen for a complete short demo.

categories.finding: The largest-collection claim is illustrated by many cards, not verified by a count. The final ROAS question broadens the promise without payoff.
Rapid variety and rich backgrounds appear designed to make research feel abundant and playful; actual response is unknown.
categories.reason: Interpretation from visual density and treatment.

categories.finding: The same prompt-box form links all scenes, but the requested product/category changes repeatedly.
Retrieval-like result states are shown. Dataset size, matching quality and improved performance are not independently checked.
The painterly botanical backgrounds and tall serif headings distinguish this from a plain SaaS demo; the prompt input itself is generic.
The first query/result pair explains the core action. More similar category cards add breadth; one real analysis response would add stronger proof.
For Tin ad research, prepare one real query, three retrieved references and a short visible analysis response.
categories.experiment: End with a specific recommended change linked to a shown reference.

categories.finding: No human new-viewer test was performed.
categories.reason: The product summary is this model’s film-only reading.

categories.finding: Mobile preview and accessibility checks were not performed.
categories.reason: Contact sheets are evidence views, not a stated mobile preview or compliance test.

lessons.keep: Keep the prompt-box shape stable while the reference category changes.
try: For Tin research, show one query, three actual reference cards and a single analysis finding using the same screen layout.
Test one restrained textured background behind large headings, with a plain area reserved for small product text.
lessons.avoid: Ending on a performance question with no answer after many quick capability claims.
lessons.open: Retrieval accuracy, dataset scale, analysis quality, sound and precise transitions remain unverified.

comparison.story: Collection scale → creator/format/ad retrieval → improvement question → trial.
comparison.motion: Collage scaling, typed query states and result appearances; sampled only.
comparison.sound: No validated listening; all sound layers unknown.
comparison.texture: Blue moon and botanical painterly fields behind clean UI; source unknown.
comparison.lesson: A repeated query/result layout explains breadth with little new UI.

scope: sampled visual and story review; ASR and measured signal support; no validated audio listening

sound.detail: No validated audio listening. Voice delivery, music, effects and mix are unknown.
sound.evidence: No actual audio perception in this review; prepared audio files are not listening evidence.
